title: Authorized YouTube OAuth and channel identity smoke (no publishing)
validationExpectations: No token, refresh token, client secret or credential plaintext is logged or versioned.
The application resolver follows OAuthConnection.tokenRef to credentialLabel youtube_oauth in an authorized runtime.
The resolved credential carries the required youtube.upload scope and is not expired.
A read-only YouTube Data API channels.list request with mine=true returns the authorized channel identity.
No videos.insert, resumable upload, thumbnail upload, scheduling or production deployment is executed.
acceptance: Authorized runtime has a connected YOUTUBE SocialAccount for the intended tenant/channel.
OAuthConnection.tokenRef resolves and decrypts the youtube_oauth vault item without exposing secret material.
Read-only channels.list(part=id,snippet,mine=true) succeeds and records only non-secret channel identity plus HTTP/evidence fingerprints.
No YouTube content is created, uploaded, scheduled, modified or published by this smoke.
Parent S-HC-PUB-07-YOUTUBE-PUBLISHING may resume only after this smoke has real authorized PASS evidence.
